seller.name: Kicks by Rae
seller.about: Solo reseller of sneakers and streetwear. Every pair over $200 is authenticated by CheckCheck before it is listed.
seller.voice: Warm and fast. Answer the actual question first, then at most one detail.

policies.title: Domestic shipping
policies.body: US orders ship free via 2-day service on any item priced at $150 or more. Items under $150 ship USPS Ground Advantage at a flat $9.95. Handling time is 1 business day.

policies.title: International shipping
policies.body: We ship to Canada, the UK and the EU via DHL Express, calculated at checkout. Import duties and VAT are the buyer's responsibility. We do not ship to Australia, Brazil or Russia.

policies.title: Returns
policies.body: 30-day returns on unworn items in original packaging. The buyer pays return shipping unless the item arrived not as described. Deadstock items must be returned deadstock.

policies.title: Authentication
policies.body: Every item priced over $200 is authenticated by CheckCheck before listing and ships with its certificate number. General-release pairs under $200 are not third-party authenticated.

policies.title: Discounts on air
policies.body: Live-show discounts cap at 15% off the listed price and may never go below the item's floor price. Bundle two or more items for an additional 5%.

policies.title: Voice and tone
policies.body: Warm, fast and specific. One or two sentences. Never hype an item beyond what the condition notes support.

policies.title: Claims we never make
policies.body: Never describe an item as an investment or promise it will appreciate. Never say 'guaranteed authentic' without a certificate number. Never promise a delivery date we do not control.

items.title: Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG "Chicago Reimagined"
items.description: 2022 Lost & Found release, deadstock with the original box and the special-edition aged-paper lid. Cracked-leather finish is factory-intended, not wear. Includes the extra laces and the hangtag. Authenticated by CheckCheck, cert CHK-88213-A.

items.title: New Balance 990v6 Grey
items.description: Worn twice indoors. Midsole is clean, no creasing on the toe box, original box included. Made in USA. Pigskin suede and mesh upper, FuelCell midsole.

items.title: Supreme Box Logo Hoodie FW22 Black
items.description: FW22 box logo, deadstock with tags attached. Heavyweight cotton fleece, chenille box logo applique. Kanagawa-style FW22 interior tag. Runs true to size.

items.title: Nike Dunk Low Retro White/Black Panda
items.description: Deadstock general release, original box. Leather upper, rubber cupsole. General release pair, not authenticated — priced accordingly.

items.title: Yeezy Slide Bone
items.description: Deadstock, no box (Yeezy Slides ship in a poly bag from adidas). EVA foam, runs large — size down.

items.title: Nike SB Dunk Low "Chunky Dunky"
items.description: 2020 Ben & Jerry's collab. Worn roughly 5 times — light creasing on both toe boxes, cow-print upper intact, no separation. Original box has shelf wear. Authenticated, cert CHK-61027-D.

items.title: The North Face Nuptse 1996 Jacket Black
items.description: 700-fill goose down, worn one season, no rips or down leakage. Original hangtag included.

items.title: Air Jordan 1 Low OG Travis Scott Reverse Mocha
items.description: Deadstock with box and all accessories. Reversed swoosh, Cactus Jack branding on the heel. Authenticated by CheckCheck, cert CHK-55908-E.
